meta.title: TEE Attestation Extractor
meta.description: Extract keyboxes from captures and verify RKP identity material offline.

scope.title: Offline processing
scope.description: Uses existing capture files. Device-side acquisition is not included. Files stay on this device; exports contain private material.

input.limit: Choose a nonempty file of at most 32 KiB. For larger captures, enter a device file path (up to 256 KiB).

keybox.description: Accepts keybox XML or PEM bundles, including material embedded in captures. Checks private-key matching and every certificate signature.
keybox.limits: Signatures and key matching are checked. Root trust and revocation are not checked; this does not prove Google acceptance.

seed.title: RKP identity
seed.description: Compare a 32-byte candidate with the signing leaf of an authenticated CSR. Choose the derivation used by the source device.
seed.offsetHint: Leave blank for an exact 32-byte input. Set a decimal offset to extract 32 bytes from a larger raw capture.
seed.matched: The candidate matches the CSR signing identity.
seed.mismatch: The candidate does not match the CSR signing identity.
seed.limits: Verifies the DICE chain and CSR signature. Matching does not prove server registration or certificate issuance. A scalar is not interchangeable with a seed.

errors.invalid_input: Cannot read the input or request.
errors.identity_mismatch: Identity does not match; nothing was exported.
errors.output_error: Could not save the complete output.
